purpose of spreading anti-Japanese propaganda. The meeting
passed a resolution in favor of immediate war on Japan. Mr.
Nakano was selected as its first victim. About 10 non-
uniformed men from Commander Chu's division led a mob of
hundreds to Mr. Nakano's shop at 4 o'clock in the afternoon.
    Crying "Kill the lackey of imperialism," they dragged
Mr. Nakano into the street and there beat and kicked him until
he was dead. The police made no attempt to interfere. --
Shanghai Nippo, Evening Edition, Sept.10.

WITHDRAWAL OF GEN. CHU SHIAO-SEN'S
ARMY ORDERED

NANNING, Sept.10 (Tatung) -- A meeting attended by
Gens. Li Tsung-jen, Pai Chung-hsi, Hwang Hsiu-tsu, and Tsai
Ting-kai was held here during the evening of Sept.8 to con-
sider the situation which has arisen as a result of the
killing of a Japanese subject at Pakhoi.
    It was decided to instruct Gen. Oong Chao-huang to
investigate the incident immediately and meanwhile to order
Gen. Chu Shiao-sen to withdraw his army from Pakhoi and
Hopo. -- Shanghai Nippo, Sept.11.
pages.zh:
《中国新闻与观点文摘》      1936年9月11日

陈立夫将主持中山大学

香港，9月9日电 -- 据消息灵通的中国人士称，国民党组织部部长、蒋介石将军的“蓝衣社”领袖陈立夫先生，将被任命兼任广州中山大学校长。-- 《上海每日新闻》晚报，9月10日。

日本通讯社报道北海谋杀案

香港，9月10日（大同社）-- 据从中国方面获得的消息，9月3日在北海杀害日本药剂师中野顺三 (Jyunzo Nakano) 先生的凶手，是朱绍森 (Chu Shiao-sen) 将军指挥的第十九路军某部的便衣人员。
    案发当天上午10时，朱指挥官召集军民开会，目的是散布反日宣传。会议通过了一项主张立即对日开战的决议。中野先生被选为第一个受害者。下午4时许，朱指挥官部下的约10名便衣人员带领数百名暴徒来到中野先生的店铺。
    他们高喊“打死帝国主义的走狗”，将中野先生拖到街上，在那里对他拳打脚踢，直至其死亡。警方未作任何干预。-- 《上海日报》(Shanghai Nippo) 晚报，9月10日。

命令朱绍森将军部队撤出

南宁，9月10日（大同社）-- 李宗仁、白崇禧、黄旭初和蔡廷锴等将军于9月8日晚在此举行会议，商讨因一名日本臣民在北海被杀而引发的局势。
    会议决定指令翁照垣 (Oong Chao-huang) 将军立即调查此事，同时命令朱绍森将军将其部队从北海和合浦撤出。-- 《上海日报》，9月11日。

pages.en:
-2-
Sept.11, 1936

GEN. CHU SHIAO-SEN'S TROOPS SAID
INTENSELY ANTI-JAPANESE

CANTON, Sept.10 (Tatung) -- The troops of Gen.
Chu Shiao-sen's army, which are believed to have been responsible
for the incident which resulted in the death of a Japanese
subject in Pakhoi on September 3, are understood to be impreg-
nated with intense anti-Japanese feeling and also to be bitterly
opposed to Gen. Chiang Kai-shek.
The Pakhoi incident was intended to break up the
compromise agreement reached between Gen. Chiang Kai-shek and
the Kwangsi leaders. -- Shanghai Nippo, Sept.11.
-----------------------

JAPANESE IN CANTON WARNED TO BE
MORE CAUTIOUS

CANTON, Sept.10 (Tatung) -- In view of the frequent
killings of Japanese subjects in recent months, a warning has
been issued to Japanese residents here by the Japanese
Consul-General, urging them to be more cautious and to avoid
walking on the streets at night. -- Shanghai Nippo, Sept.11.
-----------------------

T.L.SOONG ALLEGED TO HAVE TAKEN BRIBE
OF $3,000,000

Dr. Feng Jui, former Commissioner of Agriculture
and Forestry in the Kwangtung Provincial Government, was
executed in Canton for his greed and corruption.
In the course of his trial at the Fourth Route
Army headquarters, however, two high officials sent by Nanking
to adjust the finances of Kwangtung, were also implicated in
charges of corruption. These are Mr. T. L. Soong, Finance
Commissioner, for Kwangtung, and Mr. Tang Hai-an, the Salt
Commissioner.
These two men were found to have taken a bribe of
$3,000,000 while ostensibly working to clear the financial
administration of its former corruption.
Gen. Chiang Kai-shek, who was responsible for their
appointment, is extremely angered by the revelation of their
malfeasance, and Mr. Tang Hai-an has resigned from his post in
consequence. -- Shanghai Nippo, Sept.11.
-----------------------
pages.zh:
-2-
1936年9月11日

称朱绍森将军部队反日情绪激烈

广州，9月10日（大同社）-- 据信对9月3日导致一名日本臣民在北海死亡的事件负有责任的朱绍森将军部队，被认为充斥着强烈的反日情绪，并且强烈反对蒋介石将军。
    北海事件旨在破坏蒋介石将军与广西领导人之间达成的妥协协议。-- 《上海日报》，9月11日。
---

警告在粤日本人更加谨慎

广州，9月10日（大同社）-- 鉴于近几个月来日本臣民屡遭杀害，日本总领事已向在此的日本居民发出警告，敦促他们更加谨慎，避免夜间在街上行走。-- 《上海日报》，9月11日。
---

宋子良被指受贿300万元

前广东省政府农工局局长冯锐博士因贪婪腐败在广州被处决。
    然而，在第四路军总部对其进行的审判过程中，南京派来整顿广东财政的两名高官也被卷入腐败指控。这两人是广东财政厅厅长宋子良 (T. L. Soong) 先生和盐务局局长唐海安 (Tang Hai-an) 先生。
    经查，这两人在 ostensibly 致力于清除以往财政管理中的腐败行为时，收受了300万元的贿赂。
    负责任命他们的蒋介石将军对他们的渎职行为曝光感到极为愤怒，唐海安先生因此辞职。-- 《上海日报》，9月11日。
---

pages.en:
-3-
Sept.11, 1936

MARTIAL LAW DECLARED IN PAKHOI

HONGKONG, Sept.10 -- In view of the tense situation which has arisen consequent upon the killing of a Japanese subject on September 3, Gen. Oong Chao-huang has declared martial law in Pakhoi, according to a brief report received here last night. -- Shun Pao, Sept.11.

----------------------------------------

JAPAN TO SEND ANOTHER ECONOMIC MISSION
TO SOUTH CHINA

TOKYO, Sept.10 (Hwalien) -- Officials and business leaders here are busy organizing another mission to conduct an investigation of economic and political conditions in South China.
Members of the mission will leave Japan on October 3 and will spend about one month in the provinces of Kwangtung and Kwengsi. -- Central China Daily News, Sept.11.

----------------------------------------

JAPANESE PLANES CONTINUE FLYING TO
SHANSI

PEIPING, Sept.10 -- Despite protests by the Shansi authorities against the flight of Japanese planes over Shansi without permission, a Japanese plane, coming from Peiping, flew over Taiyuan again today. -- Chin. Evening News, Sept.10.

----------------------------------------

JAPANESE TO BUILD RAILROAD
BETWEEN PEIPING AND DOLONOR

TIENTSIN, Sept.10 -- A certain party is reported to be planning the construction of a railroad to connect the Peiping-Suiyuan Railway with Dolonor, which is situated on the border of Chahar and Jehol. This would link Dolonor directly with Peiping and Tientsin.
The proposed construction has aroused the attention of the authorities here. -- China Evening News, Sept.10.

----------------------------------------
pages.zh:
-3-
1936年9月11日

北海宣布戒严

香港，9月10日电 -- 鉴于9月3日发生杀害一名日本臣民事件后出现的紧张局势，据昨晚收到的一份简短报告称，翁照垣将军已在北海宣布戒严。-- 《申报》，9月11日。

---

日本将再派经济代表团赴华南

东京，9月10日（华联社）-- 这里的官员和商业领袖正忙于组织另一个代表团，以调查华南的经济和政治状况。
    代表团成员将于10月3日离开日本，并在广东和广西省花费约一个月时间。-- 《华中日报》，9月11日。

---

日本飞机继续飞往山西

北平，9月10日电 -- 尽管山西当局抗议日本飞机未经许可飞越山西上空，但一架来自北平的日本飞机今天再次飞越太原。-- 《中国晚报》，9月10日。

---

日本人拟修建北平至多伦诺尔铁路

天津，9月10日电 -- 据报道，某方正计划修建一条铁路，连接平绥铁路与位于察哈尔和热河边界的多伦诺尔。这将使多伦诺尔直接与北平和天津相连。
    拟议的建设工程已引起当局的关注。-- 《中国晚报》，9月10日。

---

pages.en:
-4-
Sept. 11, 1936.

JAPANESE TO EXPLOIT WOOLLEN INDUSTRY IN NORTH CHINA

TIENTSIN, Sept. 10 - The Japanese Colonial Office has decided to develop the woollen industry in North China with a capital of $1,520,000.

According to the present plan, the Japanese Government will organize an Oriental Woollen Industry Association. In the first year, $200,000 will be spent by the association for the investigation of the production of sheep wool in North China. -- Shun Pao, Sept. 11.

----------------------------------------

EIGHT OFFICES TO BE ORGANIZED
BY THE HOPEI-CHAHAR INSPECTION BUREAU

TIENTSIN, Sept. 10 - Although the regulations governing the collection of consumption taxes have not yet been approved by the Hopei-Chahar Political Council, the Hopei-Chahar Inspection Bureau is commencing work for the registration of smuggled goods.

It is reported that the smuggled goods will be taxed and released for transportation and sale in North China next week.

According to the present plan, the Bureau will organize eight offices of inspection at Peiping, Tientsin, Kalgan, and Paoting. The head office will have an expense of $5,000 per month.

The Hopei-Chahar Political Council is exchanging telegrams with the Ministry of Finance regarding the functions of the new Bureau, which the former believes does not in any way conflict with the Customs administration.

From reliable sources, it is learned that Dr. H. H. Kung, Minister of Finance is of opinion that the Bureau will be legitimate if it assists the Customs in the prevention of smuggling. If, however, it collects a tax of any kind, it will be acting to disorganize the Customs administration. -- Shun Pao, Sept. 11.

----------------------------------------
pages.zh:

1936年9月11日。

日本人拟开发华北毛纺工业

天津，9月10日电 - 日本拓务省决定出资1,520,000元开发华北的毛纺工业。

    根据目前计划，日本政府将组织一个东方毛纺工业协会。在第一年，该协会将花费200,000元用于调查华北绵羊毛的生产情况。-- 《申报》，9月11日。

---

冀察政务委员会稽查局将设立八个办事处

天津，9月10日电 - 虽然征收消费税的规定尚未得到冀察政务委员会的批准，但冀察政务委员会稽查局已开始进行走私货物登记工作。

    据报道，走私货物下周将被征税并放行，以便在华北运输和销售。

    根据目前计划，该局将在北平、天津、张家口和保定设立八个稽查办事处。总局每月经费为5,000元。

    冀察政务委员会正就新局的职能与财政部交换电报，前者认为新局在任何方面都不与海关行政相冲突。

    据可靠消息来源获悉，财政部长孔祥熙博士认为，如果该局协助海关防止走私，则是合法的。但是，如果它征收任何形式的税款，则是在扰乱海关行政。-- 《申报》，9月11日。

---

pages.en:
-5-
Sept. 11, 1936

HUNAN BORROWS $1,000,000

CHANGSHA, Sept. 10 - As the Autumn Festival is near at hand,
the Hunan Provincial Government is finding it extremely difficult
to meet its financial obligations.

In order to pay the military expenses on time, Mr. Liu Chien-
shu, Commissioner of Finance for Hunan, is negotiating with the
Hunan Provincial Government for a loan of $1,000,000. The salt
tax in the province will be pledged as security for the loan. --
Shun Pao, Sept. 11.

------------------------------

PREVENTION OF SMUGGLING IN FUKIEN SHOWS RESULTS

AMOY, Sept. 10 - The measures taken by the Customs authorities
in the prevention of smuggling along the Fukien coast have resulted
in an increase of Customs revenues and a decline in smuggling.

In August, the importy duty collected by the Amoy Customs
amounted to $934,813, a record figure for the past eight months.
Shun Pao, Sept. 11.

------------------------------

LI TSUNG-JEN WILL ASSUME POST ON SEPTEMBER 15

HONGKONG, Sept. 10 - General Li Tsung-jen, newly-appointed
Pacification Commissioner of Kwangsi, will assume his post on
September 15, according to a special report received here.

Gen. Chen Chien, Chief of Staff of the National forces, will
go to Nanning in a day or two to perform the ceremony of oath
administration.

It is reported that Gens. Huang Shao-hsiung and Chen Chen
will accompany Gen. Chen Chien on the trip. --

Mr. Liu Wei-chang, representative of Kwangsi, left Canton
today by plane for Nanning, taking with him autographed letters
of General Chiang Kai-shek. It is reported that Gen. Li Tsung-
jen has been appointed by Gen. Chiang as Commander of the 5th
Route Army (the Kwangsi troops are to be reorganized into the
5th Route Army).

MORE
pages.zh:
-5-
1936年9月11日

湖南借款100万元

长沙，9月10日电 - 由于中秋节临近，湖南省政府发现极难履行其财政义务。

    为了按时支付军费，湖南财政厅厅长刘建绪先生正与湖南省政府协商借款1,000,000元。该省的盐税将作为贷款的担保。-- 《申报》，9月11日。

---

福建防私成效显著

厦门，9月10日电 - 海关当局在福建沿海防止走私所采取的措施导致海关收入增加，走私活动减少。

    8月份，厦门海关征收的进口税达到934,813元，创过去八个月来的最高纪录。《申报》，9月11日。

---

李宗仁将于9月15日就职

香港，9月10日电 - 据此处收到的特别报告称，新任广西绥靖主任李宗仁将军将于9月15日就职。

    国军参谋长陈诚将军将在一两天内前往南宁主持宣誓仪式。

    据报道，黄绍竑将军和陈诚将军将陪同陈诚将军此行。--

    广西代表刘维章先生今天乘飞机离开广州前往南宁，随身携带蒋介石将军的亲笔信。据报道，李宗仁将军已被蒋将军任命为第五路军司令（广西部队将改编为第五路军）。

待续

pages.en:
-6-
Sept. 11, 1936.

LI TSUNG-JEN WILL ASSUME POST ON SEPT. 15 (CONTINUED):

Instructions have been telegraphed to the Kwangsi leaders
by Gen. Chiang regarding the rehabilitation of Kwangsi and the
settlement of the Pakhoi incident. -- Lih Pao, Sept. 11.

----------------------------------------

JAPANESE SUPPLY BANDITS IN NORTH CHAHAR WITH ARMS
FOR A NEW ATTACK ON EAST SUIYUAN

TIENTSIN, Sept. 10 - Fifty thousand Mongolian cavalrymen under
the command of Gen, Li Shou-hsin are now concentrated at Changpoi,
while the bandits and Manchukuo troops under the command of Pao
Yuch-chin, and Tso Shih-hai are now stationed at Shangtu and
Kongpao.

These men are supplied with fighting weapons by the Japanese.
It is expected that they will launch an attack against East
Suiyuan in the middle of September. -- Lih Pao, Sept. 11.

----------------------------------------

CHANG TZE-CHUNG ADMITS TENSE SITUATION
IN CHAHAR AND SUIYUAN

TIENTSIN, Sept.10 - General Chang Tze-chung, Mayor of Tientsin ,
in an interview with the press, admitted the existence of a tense
situation in Chahar and Suiyuan.

Gen. Chang declared further that even Ninghsia and Kansu
provinces are under serious pressure from a certain party. --
Shun Pao, Sept. 11.

----------------------------------------

FINANCE MINISTRY PLANS TO OPEN VILLAGE BANKS

SHANGHAI, Sept. 10 - For the assisting of the farmers finan-
cially, the Ministry of Finance has drawn up plans for the organi-
zation of village banks.

According to the preliminary plan, these village banks will
work closely with the Central Bank of China and will have a total
capital of $6,000,000 to be appropriated in one sum by the Ministry
of Finance.

It is expected that these village banks will be established in
1937. -- China Times, Sept. 11.
pages.zh:
-6-
1936年9月11日。

李宗仁将于9月15日就职（续）：

    蒋介石将军已致电广西领导人，指示关于广西的善后事宜及北海事件的解决。-- 《立报》，9月11日。

---

日本向察北匪徒提供武器以再次进攻绥东

天津，9月10日电 - 李守信将军指挥下的五万名蒙古骑兵现集结于张北，而宝玉珍和左世海指挥下的匪徒及满洲国部队现驻守于商都和康保。

    这些人的作战武器由日本人提供。预计他们将于9月中旬对绥远东部发动攻击。-- 《立报》，9月11日。

---

张自忠承认察绥局势紧张

天津，9月10日电 - 天津市市长张自忠将军在接受记者采访时，承认察哈尔和绥远存在紧张局势。

    张将军进一步宣称，甚至宁夏和甘肃省也正受到某方的严重压力。-- 《申报》，9月11日。

---

财政部计划开设乡村银行

上海，9月10日电 - 为了在财政上援助农民，财政部已制定组织乡村银行的计划。

    根据初步计划，这些乡村银行将与中国银行密切合作，并由财政部一次性拨付总计6,000,000元的资本。

    预计这些乡村银行将于1937年建立。-- 《字林西报》(China Times)，9月11日。

pages.en:
-7-
Sept. 11, 1936.

NO CHANGE OF PERSONNEL OF HOPEI GOVERNMENT

TIENTSIN, Sept. 10 - In an interview with the press, Gen.
Chang Tze-chung, Mayor of Tientsin, declared that the report to
the effect that he will be appointed Chairman of the Hopei Pro-
vincial Government is entirely unfounded. Gen. Chang declared
that there will be no change of the personnel of the Hopei Pro-
vincial Government.

Referring to the Sino-Japanese Power Company, Gen. Chang
declared that no definite arrangement has yet been reached for
Japanese financiers to invest money, while Chinese financiers
have already subscribed $600,000 of the total $8,000,000 capital
of the company.

It is Gen. Chang's opinion that the Sino-Japanese Power Company
will not function for some time. --China Times, Sept. 11.

----------------------------------------

JAPANESE AGRICULTURAL STATION IN HOPEI
TO BE COMPLETED

TIENTSIN, Sept. 10 - (Hwalien) - Construction of the first
Japanese Agricultural Experimental Station in Tientsin will be
completed in December, while the second and third experimental
stations will be built in Luantung and North Hopei respectively.

At Chikow, the Japanese are building a fish market and will
assist the Chinese fishermen in the area financially. -- China
Times, Sept. 11.

----------------------------------------

MORE THAN $14,000,000 IN SUBSIDIARY COINS MINTED

SHANGHAI, Sept. 10 - According to the Central Mint, $14,292,-
000 worth of subsidiary coins were minted from February to the
end of August. -- Sin Wen Pao, Sept. 11.

----------------------------------------
pages.zh:
-7-
1936年9月11日。

河北省政府人事无变动

天津，9月10日——天津市市长张自忠将军在接受记者采访时宣称，有关他将出任河北省政府主席的报道纯属子虚乌有。张将军表示，河北省政府的人事不会有变动。

谈及中日电力公司，张将军宣称，日本金融家投资事宜尚未达成确切安排，而中国金融家已认购该公司800万美元总资本中的60万美元。

张将军认为，中日电力公司在一段时间内将无法运作。——《字林西报》，9月11日。

---

河北日本农业试验站即将完工

天津，9月10日——（华联）——位于天津的第一座日本农业试验站的建设将于12月完工，第二和第三试验站将分别建在滦东和冀北。

在赤口（音译），日本人正在建设一个鱼市，并将为该地区的中国渔民提供资金援助。——《字林西报》，9月11日。

---

铸造辅币超过1400万元

上海，9月10日——据中央造币厂称，从2月至8月底，共铸造了价值14,292,000元的辅币。——《新闻报》，9月11日。

---

pages.en:
- 8 -
Sept. 11, 1936.

JAPANESE OPEN LUNGYEN COAL MINE

TIENTSIN, Sept. (Hwalien) - A plan has been agreed upon by
the Hsin Chung Company and the South Manchuria Railway Company
for the opening of the Lungyen coal mines at Shuanhua.

According to usually reliable sources, the Japanese companies
are now negotiating with the Hopei-Chahar Political Council for
the opening of these mines and it is reported that the latter
has accepted the Japanese plans. -- Central China Daily News, Sept.
11.

------------------------------------

MORE ANTI-JAPANESE VOLUNTEER ACTIVITY

CHANGCHUN, Sept. 10 - (Hwalien) - More than 100 anti-Japanese
volunteers under the command of Wang King-tze attacked a train
on the Anfeng railway, in the Shihtaitze district, last night.
A number of Japanese were killed and wounded.

The volunteers carried away large sums of money from the
Japanese passengers on the train. -- Sin Wen Pao, Sept. 11.

------------------------------------

FOREIGN POWERS ACCEPT CHINESE REQUEST
REGARDING COLLECTION OF INCOME TAX FROM FOREIGNERS

NANKING, Sept. 10 - Replies have been received from the
American, British and other Embassies to the communique of the
Ministry of Foreign Affairs regarding the collection of income
tax from foreign residents in China.

In these replies, the foreign authorities promised to assist
China in collecting income tax from foreign nationals. -- Ta
Kung Pao, Sept. 11.

------------------------------------
pages.zh:
- 8 -
1936年9月11日。

日本开采龙烟煤矿

天津，9月（华联）——新中公司与南满洲铁道株式会社已就开采宣化龙烟煤矿的计划达成一致。

据通常可靠的消息来源称，日本公司目前正与冀察政务委员会就开采这些矿井进行谈判，据报道后者已接受日本的计划。——《华中日报》，9月11日。

---

反日义勇军活动增多

长春，9月10日——（华联）——昨晚，在王敬之（音译）指挥下的100多名反日义勇军在安奉铁路石台子（音译）地区袭击了一列火车。数名日本人死伤。

义勇军从火车上的日本乘客那里掠走了大量钱财。——《新闻报》，9月11日。

---

列强接受中国关于向外侨征收所得税的请求

南京，9月10日——美国、英国及其他大使馆已就外交部关于向在华外籍居民征收所得税的照会作出回复。

在这些回复中，外国当局承诺协助中国向外国国民征收所得税。——《大公报》，9月11日。

Sept.11, 1936

ANTI-JAPANESE MOVEMENT SAID WIDESPREAD
THROUGHOUT CHINA

Commenting in an editorial today on the anti-
Japanese movement, the Shanghai Nippo declares that the
movement is now widespread through-the Chinese nation.
"Hitherto," the paper states, we have been accustomed
to focussing all our attention on the attitude of the Nanking
Government. This has to be changed. Henceforth we must not
concern ourselves solely with the question whether the
Nanking Government is, or is not, sincerely endeavoring to
suppress the anti-Japanese movement.
"For today the anti-Japanese movement is a wide-scale
movement of the whole nation. In the anti-Japanese united
front there participate all political organizations, groups
and individual who wish to fight Japan.
"Although the anti-Japanese united front is divided
into a 'People's Front' and a 'National Front,' the aim and
will to fight against Japan is common to both wings.
"In these circumstances, the Kuomintang and the
Communist Party are only two exceptionally tall trees in the
big forest of the anti-Japanese movement. Henceforth we must
pay attention to the whole forest and not confine it to the
taller trees."

TA KUNG PAO URGES REAL NATIONAL
UNIFICATION

Declaring that with the Kwangsi trouble settled, the
authorities should now seek to encompass true national unifi-
cation, the Ta Kung Pao writes in an editorial today:
"Attempts should be made to secure the assistance of
all Chinese to help the country at the present time of national
crisis. To this end, the authorities should release the pol-
itical prisoners, revise the orders prohibiting freedom of
press and organization, make known the government's policies,
and maintain a close cooperation with the educational leaders
of the country."
Referring to the duty of the people toward the govern-
ment, the paper asks, the people to love their country and the
government officials. "It must be noted that the government
officials are not infallible. They have their shortcomings, but
these must be regarded sympathetically. Only thus can there be
true cooperation between the government and the people."

1936年9月11日

据称反日运动在中国各地广泛展开

《上海日日新闻》在今日一篇评论反日运动的社论中宣称，该运动现在已遍及全中国。该报称：“迄今为止，我们习惯于将全部注意力集中在南京政府的态度上。这一点必须改变。今后，我们不应仅仅关注南京政府是否真诚努力镇压反日运动的问题。
“因为今天的反日运动是一场全国范围的大规模运动。在反日统一战线中，所有希望抗击日本的政治组织、团体和个人都参与其中。
“虽然反日统一战线分为‘人民阵线’和‘民族阵线’，但两派抗击日本的目标和意志是共同的。
“在这种情况下，国民党和共产党只是反日运动这片大森林中两棵特别高大的树木。今后我们必须关注整片森林，而不要局限于那几棵较高的树。”

《大公报》呼吁实现真正的国家统一

《大公报》在今日一篇社论中写道，随着广西事变的平息，当局现在应寻求实现真正的国家统一：
“应设法争取全体中国人的协助，以帮助国家度过目前的民族危机。为此，当局应释放政治犯，修订禁止新闻和组织自由的命令，公布政府政策，并与全国教育界领袖保持密切合作。”
谈及人民对政府的义务，该报呼吁人民热爱国家和政府官员。“必须指出，政府官员并非永不犯错。他们也有缺点，但必须予以同情地看待。只有这样，政府与人民之间才能有真正的合作。”

Sept. 11, 1936.

ON THE CHENGTU AND PAKHOI INCIDENTS

Commenting on the Chengtu and Pakhoi incidents, the Lih Pao
in an editorial today writes:

"It is unfortunate these two incidents occurred lately in
Chengtu and Pakhoi. We hope that they can be settled through
the regular diplomatic channels and that the people of the two
countries will do their best to eliminate the hatred and bad
feeling now prevailing.

"China and Japan are the leading countries in the Far East
and most of the peoples of these two countries are peace-loving
and ought to maintain peace in Asia. However, developments in
recent years have created serious misunderstandings between the
peoples of the two countries and incidents have complicated their
relationships.

"The Japanese press declared that the incidents indicate the
revival of the anti-Japanese movement. To this, we think it is
appropriate to reply that these incidents occurred because of the
change of color of the Chinese map in a number of places. We hope
the newspapers of our friendly neighbour will observe a far-
sighted attitude, so as not to aggravate the present greatly strain-
ed situation."

关于成都和北海事件

《立报》在今日一篇评论成都和北海事件的社论中写道：

“最近在成都和北海发生这两起事件是不幸的。我们希望它们能通过正常的外交渠道得到解决，并希望两国人民尽力消除目前普遍存在的仇恨和不良情绪。

“中国和日本是远东的主要国家，这两个国家的大多数人民都是爱好和平的，应当维护亚洲的和平。然而，近年来的事态发展造成了两国人民之间的严重误解，各种事件使他们的关系复杂化。

“日本报刊宣称，这些事件表明反日运动的复兴。对此，我们认为适当的回应是，这些事件的发生是因为中国地图在许多地方的颜色发生了变化。我们希望我们友好邻邦的报纸能采取远见的态度，以免加剧目前极度紧张的局势。”

29th. ARMY SAID READY TO FIGHT JAPAN

TIENTSIN, Sept. 5 (Tatung Agency) -- A cavalry regiment of
the 29th Army, which is under the command of Gen. Sung Cheh-
yuan, chairman of the Hopei-Chahar Political Council, is
moving from Tsangchow through Yungchen and Tsochow, two cities
situated on the Peiping-Hankow Railway, towards the western
suburbs of Peiping.

This cavalry movement is regarded as preparatory to open
warfare against the Japanese troops in North China. The aim
of the cavalry is to establish a close connection with the main
body of the 29th. Army which is stationed at Nanyuen in the
southern suburbs of Peiping. -- Shanghai Mainichi, Sept. 6

REPORTED BRIBE FOR GEN. HAN FU-CHU

TIENTSIN, Sept. 5 (Tatung Agency) -- General Chiang Pei-chen,
personal representative of Gen. Chiang Kai-shek, has arrived in
Tsinan and is reported to have brought with him the sum of
one million dollars with which to bribe Gen. Han Fu-chu, prov-
incial governor of Shantung.

A lieutenant in the army of Gen. Sung Cheh-yuan, chairman
of the Hopei-Chahar Political Council, is also reported to
arrived in Tsinan on a secret mission. -- Shanghai Mainichi,
Sept. 6.

AMERICAN MISSIONARY UNIVERSITY BLAMED

HANKOW, Sept. 5 -- According to information gathered from
foreign residents in the Szechwan capital, the recent riot in
that city, which resulted in the death of two Japanese subjects
and injury to two others, was staged under the leadership of
students of the West China University, an American missionary

第29军据称已准备好对日作战

天津，9月5日（大通社）——隶属于冀察政务委员会委员长宋哲元将军的第29军的一个骑兵团，正从沧州经由平汉铁路上的永清和涿州两座城市，向北平西郊移动。

-2e                                                                 Sept.7, 1936

KUOMINTANG BLAMED FOR CHENGTU RIOT

CHUNGKING, Sept.4 -- Following the recent Chengtu incident,
in which two Japanese subjects were killed and two others badly
injured, the Chinese government declared that Communists were
to blame for the incident. However, many new facts have been
discovered which prove the incident to have been staged accord-
ing to a carefully prepared plan, the purpose of which was to
prevent Mr. Iwai, the newly-appointed Japanese Consul at Chengtu,
from assuming his post. These facts are as follows:

1. When the mob attacked the Great Szechuen Hotel a search
was started for the Japanese Consul and members of the crowd
shouted "Deport Iwai!" The riot lasted about two hours and
during all of that period the police stood by without inter-
fering. When the rioters seized Mr. Saito, they questioned him:
"Iwai arrived here by airplane -- where is he now?"

2. Before the riot commenced, members of the mob questioned
the four subsequent victims as to whether they were on the staff
of the new Japanese Consul. From this fact it can be seen that
the riot was under the leadership of the local Kuomintang organ-
isation, which aimed to prevent Mr. Iwai from taking over his
post.

3. On the night of August 23, when it had become known that
Mr. Iwai would reach Chengtu the following day, placards de-
nouncing the reopening of the Japanese Consulate in Chengtu made
their appearance on the streets. These posters were put up by
students and well-dressed men who went about their work in a
manner suggesting that they did not fear any action by the police.

4. On August 28, when news had spread that the secretary of
the new consulate, Mr. Matsumuro, had arrived in the city, the
agitation was renewed. Judging by the quick reaction to the news
and the planned character of the campaign, it is obvious that the
whole affair was under Kuomintang direction. -- Shanghai Nichi-
Nichi, Sept.6.
pages.zh:
-2e                                                                 1936年9月7日

国民党被指为成都骚乱之祸首

重庆，9月4日电——继近期发生两名日本臣民遇害、另两人重伤的成都事件后，中国政府宣称共产党应对此事件负责。然而，许多新发现的事实证明，该事件是基于一项精心策划的计划而制造的，其目的是阻止新任日本驻成都领事岩井先生（Mr. Iwai）就职。这些事实如下：

1. 当暴徒袭击大四川饭店（Great Szechuen Hotel）时，他们开始搜寻日本领事，人群中高呼“驱逐岩井！”骚乱持续了约两小时，在此期间，警察袖手旁观，未加干涉。当暴徒抓住斋藤先生（Mr. Saito）时，他们质问他：“岩井乘飞机抵达此处——他现在在哪里？”

2. 在骚乱开始前，暴徒成员曾询问随后的四名受害者是否属于新任日本领事的 staff。从这一事实可以看出，骚乱是在当地国民党组织的领导下进行的，其目的是阻止岩井先生上任。

3. 8月23日晚，当得知岩井先生将于次日抵达成都的消息后，街道上出现了谴责重新开设日本驻成都领事馆的标语。这些海报是由学生和衣着体面的男子张贴的，他们的行事方式表明他们并不害怕警方的任何行动。

4. 8月28日，当新领事馆秘书松室先生（Mr. Matsumuro）抵达该市的消息传开后，煽动活动再次兴起。鉴于对消息的快速反应以及此次运动的计划性特征，显然整个事件是在国民党的指挥下进行的。——《上海日日新闻》，9月6日。

DR. LO WEN-KAN TO BECOME A MONK?

HONGKONG, Sept.5 -- Following the political downfall of
Gen. Chen Chi-tang, former warlord of Kwangtung, Dr. Lo Wen-kan,
erstwhile minister of foreign affairs in the Nanking Government,
has decided to become a Buddhist monk and to enter the famous

the assumption of control in Kwangtung by Gen. Chiang Kai-shek,
he has apparently decided to quit politics for good. -- Shanghai

"NEW LIFE" EDITOR BEING RELEASED

SHANGHAI, Sept.6 -- Mr. Tu Chung-yuan, editor of the New
Life Weekly who was sentenced to serve one year and two months

罗文干博士要出家为僧？

香港，9月5日电——继广东前军阀陈济棠将军政治失势后，南京政府前外交部长罗文干博士决定出家为佛教僧侣，并进入广东著名的龙坞寺（Lungwoo Monastery，音译）。在长期远离政坛后，罗博士曾以西南政务委员会成员的身份重返政坛，但随着蒋介石将军掌控广东后该机构被废除，他显然已决定彻底退出政界。——《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo），9月6日。

“新生活”周刊编辑获释

上海，9月6日电——《新生活周刊》编辑屠仲元先生因发表一篇题为《皇帝闲话》的文章而被判处一年两个月徒刑，该文章被日本当局视为具有冒犯性。他将于9月9日服满刑期并获释。——上海《华中日报》，9月7日。

日本驻天津领事馆将扩充

Sept. 7, 1936

GENERAL CHIANG CONCEDES KWANGSI DEMANDS

NANKING, Sept.6 -- Cancelling its former demands that Generals Li Tsung-jen and Pai Chung-hsi, Kwangsi warlords, should leave that province and assume posts offered them else-where, the Nanking government, it is learned, has now agreed that the two recalcitrants should remain where they are. General Li, it is understood, will be commander-in-chief of the Kwangsi forces, while General Pai, as his second in command, will be made a member of the Military Affairs Commission.

In view of these concessions by Nanking, a peaceful ending to the Nanking-Kwangsi trouble is now believed to be assured.

The motivation for the concessions, which have been made at the instance of Gen. Chiang Kai-shek, is believed to be the complication brought about by the recent Chengtu incident in which two Japanese subjects lost their lives, while two others were badly injured. They were, in part, also motivated by the stubborn resistance which the Kwangsi leaders showed towards the demands of Nanking.

In making the concessions, it is noted that Gen. Chiang has failed to achieve his cherished purpose of liquidating his two most important rivals. The Kwangsi generals, utilizing the banner of an anti-Japanese movement, have rallied around them-selves all the anti-Japanese and anti-Chiang Kai-shek elements, notably the reorganized 19th Route Army and Third Party people who recently flocked into Kwangsi.

Under the pressure which these elements will exercise it is considered likely that henceforth Gen. Chiang will pursue a much more determined anti-Japanese policy. Shanghai Mainichi, Sept. 7.

1936年9月7日

蒋介石将军接受广西方面要求

南京，9月6日电——据悉，南京政府已取消此前要求广西军阀李宗仁和白崇禧两位将军离开该省并就任其他地方职位的要求，转而同意这两名不服从者留在原地。据了解，李将军将担任广西部队总司令，而白将军作为其副手，将被任命为军事委员会委员。

鉴于南京方面的这些让步，人们现在相信南京与广西之间的纠纷将以和平方式结束。

据信，这些由蒋介石将军主导做出的让步，其动机部分是近期成都事件造成的复杂局面，该事件中两名日本臣民丧生，另两人重伤。部分动机也源于广西领导人对南京要求的顽固抵抗。

值得注意的是，在做出让步时，蒋介石将军未能实现其铲除两个最重要对手的夙愿。广西将军们利用抗日运动的旗帜，将所有反日和反蒋介石的势力聚集在自己周围，特别是最近涌入广西的重组后的第十九路军和第三党人士。

在这些势力施加的压力下，人们认为蒋介石今后可能会推行更加坚决的反日政策。《上海每日新闻》，9月7日。

Sept.7, 1936

"NIPPO" COMMENTS ON CONCESSIONS
MADE TO KWANGSI

Pressed by the unfavorable situation created by the
Chengtu incident and the strong attitude adopted by the
Kwangsi generals, Gen. Chiang Kai-shek has been compelled to
make great concessions to Kwangsi.

Gen. Chiang was most anxious to settle the Kwangsi
difficulty as quickly as possible and sent Dr. Wang Chung-hwei,
Mr. Chu Chen and Gen. Chu Pei-teh to Nanning to conduct neg-
otiations.

The first condition which he laid down was that Generals
Li Tsung-jen and Pai Chung-hsi should leave Kwangsi and go
abroad. But the Kwangsi leaders rejected this demand and
ordered the troops under Gen. Oong Chao-yuan to move into
southern Kwangtung. Fearing attack, the Kwangtung troops
withdrew from their positions.

At this point, Gen. Chiang abandoned all hope of
securing a fundamental solution of the Kwangsi problem and
resigned himself to losing face in an endeavor to reach a
compromise agreement with the Kwangsi leaders. The concessions
he has now made are the result.

But can one say that the Kwangsi group has scored a
great success? No. Even the Kwangsi leaders themselves would
not make such a claim. Gen. Chiang's policy is to isolate
Kwangsi and "let it die." Having conquered Kwangtung, he expects
to liquidate the Kwangsi group by means of economic blockade.
Hence, the compromise which has been effected can only be re-
garded as a brief interlude in Gen. Chiang's plan to unify
the country. The plan has definitely not been abandoned and
the compromise now reached is actually a capitulation of
Kwangsi to Nanking.

1936年9月7日

《日报》评论对广西的让步

受成都事件造成的不利局势以及广西将军们采取的强硬态度的逼迫，蒋介石将军被迫对广西做出重大让步。

蒋介石将军急于尽快解决广西难题，派遣王宠惠博士、朱琛先生和朱培德将军前往南宁进行谈判。

他提出的第一个条件是李宗仁和白崇禧两位将军离开广西并出国。但广西领导人拒绝了这一要求，并命令翁照垣将军（Gen. Oong Chao-yuan，音译）麾下的部队进入广东南部。由于担心受到攻击，广东部队从阵地上撤退。

此时，蒋介石将军放弃了寻求从根本上解决广西问题的所有希望，甘愿丢脸，试图与广西领导人达成妥协协议。他目前做出的让步即是结果。

但是，能否说广西集团取得了巨大成功？不能。即使是广西领导人自己也不会这样声称。蒋介石的政策是孤立广西并“使其自毙”。在征服广东后，他期望通过经济封锁来清除广西集团。因此，达成的妥协只能被视为蒋介石统一国家计划中的短暂插曲。该计划肯定没有被放弃，目前达成的妥协实际上是广西向南京的投降。

This, of course, is well known to Generals Li Tsung-
jen and Pai Chung-hsi. Hence, if they wish to consolidate their

collaboration. For this, propitious circumstances are required.

Mr. S. Kawagoe, Japanese ambassador to China, regarding the
opening of negotiations with the Nanking authorities in regard

川越茂赴南京就成都事件进行谈判

南京，9月6日电——据当地外交界消息，日本驻华大使川越茂先生（S. Kawagoe）已收到关于就近期成都事件与南京当局开启谈判的指示。

COMMUNISTS DEFEATED IN KANSU

SIAN, Sept.6 -- The communist amics in Kansu are now
concentrated at Chungpao and Matzechuan. After launching an
attack on government troops at Minchen and Erlangshan they
suffered a severe defeat.

Communist troops which attacked Lintao were defeated by
government troops on September 3. -- Ta Kung Pao, Sept. 7.

WANG KEH-MIN CALLS ON JAPANESE IN MUKDEN

TIENTSIN, Sept.6 -- After three conferences with high
officials of the South Manchuria Railway Company, Mr. Wang
Keh-min, newly appointed chairman of the Economic Committee
of the Hopei-Chahar Political Council, left for Mukden today
by rail with the intention of visiting the chief-of-staff
of the Japanese Kwantung Army.

It is stated that Mr. Wang will return to Tientsin and
also visit Peiping after a short stay in Mukden. His work
will consist in bringing about Sino-Japanese cooperation in
North China.

According to another report, Mr. Wang will proceed to
Tsingtao from Mukden and no date has yet been set for his
arrival in Tientsin. -- Lih Pao, Sept.7.

president of Fuh Tan University, prominent Indian scholars

India next March.

politics will be discussed. Dr. Li has been invited by Indian
friends to attend the conference. Lih Pao, Sept. 7.

TA KUNG PAO COMMENTS ON SETTLEMENT
OF KWANGSI TROUBLE

The Kwangsi problem has been settled satisfactorily to
the good fortune of the nation and the country, declares
the Ta Kung Pao in editorial comment on the situation today
(Sept.7).

When the conflict began, the paper states, we hoped that
the conscience and commonsense would triumph. Now this has
come to pass. But there are instructive lessons to be drawn
from the conflict.

First to be noted is the attitude of toleration by
Gen. Chiang Kai-shek. This, more than anything else, resulted
in a peaceful outcome of the difficulty. Secondly, Gen. Chiang
showed the greatest forbearance in the face of the insulting
telegrams which were sent to him by the Kwangsi generals.

On the other hand, Generals Li and Pai did not go the
length of organizing their own government. For that they must
be given credit.

It is to be hoped that the triumph of commonsense will
remain and become universal through the country, for this
will benefit the whole nation, including the people of
Kwangsi.

《大公报》评论广西事变之解决

《大公报》在今日（9月7日）关于局势的社论中宣称，广西问题已得到圆满解决，此乃国家民族之幸。

该报称，冲突伊始，我们曾希望良知与常识能够获胜。如今这一愿望已成现实。但从这场冲突中仍可吸取有益的教训。

首先值得注意的是蒋介石将军的宽容态度。这一点比其他任何因素都更促成了此次危机的和平解决。其次，面对广西将领发来的侮辱性电报，蒋将军表现出了极大的克制。

另一方面，李宗仁和白崇禧将军并未走到组织自己政府的地步。对此应予以肯定。

希望常识的胜利能够保持并在全国范围内普及，因为这将使包括广西人民在内的整个民族受益。

---

《申报》评论英日关系

《申报》今日就英国新任驻华大使许阁森爵士（Sir Hughe Knatchbull-Hugessen）与日本政府官员即将在东京举行的谈判发表评论写道：

“英国驻华大使在访问华盛顿和多伦多后已抵达东京。在离开伦敦之前，他会见了李滋罗斯爵士（Sir Frederick Leith-Ross），后者曾花费九个月时间调查本国的经济和金融状况。他还拜访了日本驻伦敦大使。

Sept.7, 1936

SHUN PAO ON ANGLO-JAPANESE RELATIONS
(CONTINUED)

The present visit of the ambassador to Tokyo to exchange views
with Japanese officials regarding Anglo-Japanese and Sino-
Japanese relations is of the utmost importance for China.

"It is most extraordinary for a diplomat to discuss prob-
lems pertaining to the country to which he is accredited before
he has presented his credentials and assumed office. In the
present case, however, it is understandable. Both Britain and
Japan are eager to arrive at common aims.

"For China, this is a time at which Japan and Britain
should come to an understanding. With the solution of the
southwest problem, and the unification of China and the opening
of Sino-Japanese negotiations, it is obvious that economic
conflicts will be aggravated. The time is therefore ripe to
find a solution of the situation.

"Present-day developments in the international situation
demand a new adjustment of Anglo-Japanese relations. Since Spain
is likely to go fascist, Britain is obliged to adopt a more
conciliatory attitude towards Japan. Japan meanwhile has great
worries over markets, since Manchuria has not turned out to be
a promised land in this respect and she has not yet completed
her domination of China. Because of this, Japan is willing to
reconsider her relations with Britain.

"There are many reports which indicate the likelihood of
an Anglo-Japanese rapprochement. It is even reported that
Sir Samuel Hoare favors extension of British recognition to
Manchukuo with recognition of Japan's special interests in
China. The Japanese, on their part, are prepared to reaffirm
respect for China's territorial integrity, the open door pol-
icy, coupled with due recognition of Britain's interests in
China. Although reports along these lines have been denied, their
significance cannot be denied or ignored."

《申报》论英日关系（续）

大使此次访问东京，就英日关系和中日关系与日本官员交换意见，对中国至关重要。

“外交官在递交国书并就职之前，讨论与其受派国家相关的问题，这是极不寻常的。然而，在目前的情况下，这是可以理解的。英国和日本都渴望达成共同目标。

“对中国而言，现在是日本和英国达成谅解的时刻。随着西南问题的解决、中国的统一以及中日谈判的开启，经济冲突显然将会加剧。因此，现在是寻求解决这一局势的成熟时机。

“当前国际局势的发展要求对英日关系进行新的调整。由于西班牙可能走向法西斯主义，英国不得不采取对日更为缓和的态度。与此同时，日本在市场方面面临巨大担忧，因为满洲在这方面并未成为应许之地，且日本尚未完成对中国的支配。正因如此，日本愿意重新考虑其与英国的关系。

“有许多报道表明英日亲善的可能性。甚至有报道称，塞缪尔·霍尔爵士（Sir Samuel Hoare）倾向于扩大英国对满洲国的承认，并承认日本在华的特殊利益。日本方面则准备重申尊重中国领土完整和门户开放政策，同时适当承认英国在华利益。尽管此类报道已被否认，但其意义不容否认或忽视。”
